scope: Source/interface adoption only; no runtime replay or executable implementation qualification

ownership.externalQueueRouting: Root parent CLI queue, after countersign; no native or publisher concurrency inferred

runtimeGrant.admissionRule: Every mutation/native slot requires its separately reviewed Root release, current identities/nonces/expiry/resource ownership and actual settlement.

receiptBoundary: Unison semantic-DNG/clone/delivery receipts alone cannot authorize preview reuse or the current native digest. Verify immutable source/settings/dependency epochs and exactly what pixel/metadata semantic domain the tooling covered. XMP, metadata or rendering-dependency changes invalidate the affected captured/rendered results even when payload pixels compare equal.
amendmentPolicy: A changed normative field or qualification scope requires a new immutable version or explicitly pinned evidence addendum; never edit sealed receipts.
